LBY.note: The link is between a social grant and the Civil Status Authority, not between the civil register and an ID system.
Says nothing about digital registration of births or deaths.
Says nothing about an ID number at birth.
Does not say how local offices enter events.

facts.fact: On 10 July 2025 Libya's Ministry of Social Affairs (Minister Wafaa al-Kilani) followed up activation of the electronic link of the wife-and-children grant project, built with the Civil Status Authority, to keep data accurate and stop delays and duplicate payments.
facts.system: Wife and Children Grant electronic link
